text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
(I can go further—faster! I'll surpass the
limits
imposed upon me!)

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
(To a new frontier of speed, where no

Umamusume has tread before!)

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
With a mad dash bordering on hysteria,
Agnes
Tachyon renders the crowd
speechless at the
autumn Tenno Sho.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
They sit transfixed in a breathless
silence.

text_block_list.name: Caster
text_block_list.text:
Crossing the finish line is Agnes
Tachyon!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Seconds later, the crowd erupts into a
thunderous
roar celebrating the winner.

text_block_list.name: Fan A
text_block_list.text: Thank goodness, Agnes Tachyon!

text_block_list.name: Fan B
text_block_list.text: Watching that gave me goosebumps!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: Huff... puff... Phew...

text_block_list.name: Fan A
text_block_list.text: Tachyon! Great job!

text_block_list.name: Fan B
text_block_list.text: You were amazing!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Agnes Tachyon flashes a smile towards
the
nonstop cheering coming from the
stands.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Thank you for your support! Your voices
gave me
strength!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The crowd lets out another resounding
cheer.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Agnes Tachyon comes back with the
crowd still
cheering and whistling behind
her.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: Trainer! Thanks for waiting for me again!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
I must say, that was incredible. Almost
something
akin to idolatry. I might even
be venerated
postmortem.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
However... it doesn't feel bad to bask in
their
cheers. I might even describe it as
pleasant, like
electricity coursing
through my veins.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Suddenly, a look of worry spreads across
her face.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
I came so close to reaching the limits of
the
Umamusume body today...

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: But of course, I fell one step short.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
My body was prepared. I had the
requisite skill
and talent. I even
thoroughly noted the effect of
the
crowd's interference.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
This is the first that I'm asking you
something like
this, but it might also be
the last—what is it that I
am lacking?

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
I'm not talking about that. I'm talking
about the
missing factor for my victory.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Look, I'll even entertain one of those
wishy-washy
elements like love,
aspiration, courage, or
whatever.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
We put our heads together but fail to
come up
with anything viable.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
In any case, in two months, our goal for
this
year—the Arima Kinen—will be upon
us.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
What better stage is there to prove
myself?
Wouldn't you agree?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
With the Arima Kinen on the horizon, I
begin
seeking for an answer to what
she's lacking.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
A lone figure stands behind Agnes
Tachyon,
staring intently at her from
behind.
